articles.title: At AI-Fueled Market Party, Wall Street Eyes the Rates Punch Bowl - Bloomberg.com
articles.description: Enthusiasm for Big Tech and its huge investments in artificial intelligence is powering the stock market to record highs again. With a resilient economy and scorching demand, there’s seemingly only one obstacle that can derail this ride: higher interest rates.
